title.zh: 将安蒂克省哈姆蒂克市镇伊拉亚描笼涯中学的名称变更为Julio V. Macuja州长纪念综合中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Iraya Barangay High School in the Municipality of Hamtic, Province of Antique, to Governor Julio V. Macuja Memorial Comprehensive High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Iraya Barangay High School in the Municipality of Hamtic, Province of Antique, to Governor Julio V. Macuja Memorial Comprehensive High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6745_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Iraya Barangay High School in the Municipality of Hamtic, Province of Antique, is hereby changed to Governor Julio V. Macuja Memorial Comprehensive High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
